scenario: LRST.6.1 — `after <dur> as <expr>:` extends the unified `as` correlation surface to timer clauses. The expression evaluates against the rule's LHS bindings at scheduling time and supplies the per-fact supersedure key for the synthesised timer fact (LTAC.3.2 / LTAC.3.5). Pin: a rule with `after 5_min as t.entity_id:` parses and compiles cleanly.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: String mutable

rule notify:
    Trig t
->
    after 5_min as t.entity_id:
        log info "deferred notify"
